faqs.question: How can I get into Sri Krishna Engineering College for UG/PG courses? Am I eligible for admission?
faqs.answer:
Sri Krishna Engineering College has below criteria for taking admissions to it's various courses:
Courses Eligibility
B.E. / B.Tech Candidate must have passed VIII, IX, X, XI & XII Std. from schools situated in Tamil Nadu. Tamil Nadu native candidate who have passed any of the VIII, IX, X, XI & XII Std. or their equivalent exam from schools situated outside Tamil Nadu can also apply. They should produce Original Nativity Certificate. Children of Central Government Employees, irrespective of their nativity, provided their parents or guardians (only if both parents are not alive) have been serving in Tamil Nadu continuously for the past five years can be eligible to apply. Sons & daughters of All India service Tamil Nadu cadre officers are eligible to apply. A Self declaration from the parent in this regard is to be produced. Children of employees in the Public Sector or Government recognised institutions had been working in their organisations for the past five years are also eligible, irrespective of their domicile. Other State candidates who have studied VIII, IX, X, XI and XII Std. in Tamil Nadu are eligible to apply.
MBA/PGDM Candidate who have completed 10+2+AMIE or 10+3 years Diploma + AMIE are also eligible. AMIE candidate must have 2 years regular full time experience in the relevant field.
M.E./M.Tech Candidate who have completed 10+2+AMIE or 10+3 years Diploma + AMIE are also eligible. AMIE candidate must have 2 years regular full time experience in the relevant field.

review_summary.college_name: MGAHV - Mahatma Gandhi Antarrashtriya Hindi Vishwavidyalaya Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Ed. in Mathematics - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I think the best university for B.Ed is MGAHV. B.Ed was easy with MGAHV.

content.Placements: No placements were available, but internships were offered to students. Most of the courses were linguistic, leading to a lack of placements. Law studies and management were conducted in Hindi medium. However, regular seminars were held, and the university had a good reputation. Thank you.
content.Infrastructure: The overall infrastructure of the university was good. Five hostels were provided for boys and two for girls. Rooms were spacious and better than those in many central universities. Almost all students received hostel accommodation along with food. The food, water, and security were well-maintained.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor's Degree with Research in Psychology - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Students can learn and grow many things from our college.

content.Placements: At present, our college doesn't provide placements for our course. But a few students get placed after completing their degree in the private sector. Most of the degree holders, enrolled for master's degrees in other universities where they can get opportunities to enhance their CVs.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is modern and fully embedded with all facilities required for a modern education system. Our classrooms are installed with a digital learning system to ensure the digital learning of students. Our college is Wi-Fi enabled to ensure data and network access to students. Labs are available for required subjects such as psychology, anthropology, mass communication, etc. Hostels are provided with all facilities such as semi-furnished rooms, bathrooms with geysers, gym and entertainment hall, etc. The food served in the hostel is good. Our college has only one canteen. The canteen is not available in the hostel. Our university has its free-of-cost dispensary. Our college provides free-of-cost ambulance and medical cards to students. Our college provides us with sports facilities like a badminton court, basketball courts, and volleyball court. A ground field is available on campus for students.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Spanish Language - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Our campus was established in 1997 with an A grade.

content.Placements: In our course, average students get placed depending on their knowledge. Multinational companies visit our college to hire students from our course. Many roles like tourist guider, data analyst, language expert, etc., are offered in our course.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, a library, classrooms, a playground, a huge auditorium, etc. It provides medical facilities, 24x7 ambulance facilities, mess facilities, sports instruments, and ground facilities on the campus for students.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in French Language - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of MGAHV - Mahatma Gandhi Antarrashtriya Hindi Vishwavidyalaya.

content.Placements: Our college provides average placements. Top recruiting companies do not visit our campus.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is excellent. The hostel fee is Rs. 1800 per year. The mess fee is Rs. 2400 per month. Rooms are huge. Two students share a room with a chair and a table. A central library and a hostel library are available. In our college, cafeterias, gyms, and auditoriums are available. Many computer labs are available for students.
content.Faculty: Our teachers are helpful. They guide us. You must select two elective subjects in addition to the core. Variety of programs are offered at our college, including B.Ed., BCA, and Ph.D. in Japanese, French, Spanish, and Chinese.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: This course will make your future better.

content.Placements: In our college, almost 80% of students were placed in our course. Placements were very good in our college. The average salary package offered was 10 LPA and the highest salary package offered was 40 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Sony, etc., visited our campus.
content.Infrastructure: Our college had excellent facilities. There were many different departments. There were different teachers for all departments. There was a HOD for each department. Hostel facilities were good at our college. The hostel fee was Rs. 8,000 per year.

paragraphs: GNIHM admissionsare currently open for all the courses. The institute offers admission to the courses based on the score of the aspirants in JET. Aspirants must fulfil both the eligibility and selection criteria for admission. Check below the steps to get a seat in the institute:
1: GNIHM Kolkata Application Process 2026

The admission process starts with filling out the GNIHM Kolkata application form. Interested candidates can visit the official website of GNIHM Kolkata to apply for the course of their choice by paying an application fee.
2: GNIHM Kolkata Entrance Exam

The institute conducts its entrance exam for admission to courses. GNIHM JET consists of 60 multiple-choice questions with no negative Marking. The exam is conducted in Kolkata, Patna, New Delhi, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Kochi, Chandigarh, and Raipur campuses. Also, interested candidates can appear online for this exam.
3: Selection

The facilities of the hostel are not that good, as the public washrooms are mostly dirty, foods are sometimes not good, and rooms are spacious but have only si...

reviews.review_heading: Top quality of education is given here.

reviews.review_heading: Very good infrastructure to be in.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with good faculty, placements and amenities.

Individual bed, cupboard, study table, with 4 times food, separate hostels for girls and boys inside and outside of campus are there.
Badminton, basketball court, football, cricket ground and ample space to play are there.
Food available is healthy and good enough for all people to eat.

reviews.review_heading: Best Hospitality and Hotel Management College in eastern India.

The labs are well-equipped with all the latest equipments at par with the industry and this experience will definitely make you industry ready.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college, that's what I can say.
reviews.review_text: This college has a huge infrastructure. It has 3 huge  playgrounds where various sports activities are organised for students, faculty members & staffs. It has a very good & modernized hostel facility for the students with Wi-Fi, and many other facilities.

reviews.review_heading: World class institute offering the best of all amenities.
reviews.review_text: Superb infrastructure of high standard is available. I am impressed with the huge and excellent infrastructure. Classrooms are very advanced which help us to get motivated. High class library with various types of hospitality related books is present. Food quality of canteen is very good good. Annual sports are held every year for cricket, football and badminton.

reviews.review_heading: Best hospitality and hostel management college in eastern india.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of GNIHM is the best. We have all modern amenities and the services that we get are praise worthy. This institute not only focuses on academics but also prepares you as a team player through the various sports activities it organizes. Food offered in the canteen is good but has scope for improvement. It can start selling other food items too besides rice etc.

reviews.review_heading: Really good college with good faculty, placements, and amenities.
reviews.review_text: Our College practical labs for all separate departments enough for all students to get hands-on training, Library, Computer Lab, Theory Classrooms. Also has hostel facilities separate for boys and girls with 4 times food a day. We also have sports ground for football cricket badminton basketball. A minimum of 5 cultural programs and fests, competitions are organized throughout the year, with adequate medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Not very happy because of bad placement campusing.

review_summary.college_name: Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: LNIPE, one for all, all for one.

content.Placements: Mini internships are provided by the institution itself for 30 days, during which we have to go to local schools and teach students March past and mass demonstration. We also receive a stipend for that. In the 4th year, we have to complete a 45-day internship at schools or other places of our choice, and we may or may not get a stipend there. We have to do the internship as physical education teachers.
content.Infrastructure: In LNIPE, you have to stay in hostels, you cannot opt for staying outside during your Bachelor's and Master's degrees. The social life is very inclusive, with intramurals taking place all around the year, and seniors and juniors live like siblings. There are 5 hostels for UG boys and 3 for UG girls. Outings are allowed only on Saturday and Sunday for girls, while boys can go whenever they want, to be honest. Classrooms are well-lit, and there is enough space for every student. Wi-Fi facility are available in both the college buildings and hostels. Classrooms consist of smart boards in addition to green boards and whiteboards.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The Best Physical Education and Sports College.

content.Placements: The highest package is 9 lakh p.a, the average package offered is 6 lakh p.a, and the lowest package offered is about 3.5 to 4 lakh p.a. Private schools, Army schools, and the topmost schools of the country recruit from here. The best thing is that the internship is compulsory for all. In the 6th semester, students are allotted schools by the college for a 1-month internship. In the 7th semester, students choose their own internship and decide which school to do it in, whether in any school of India or abroad. The college sends offers to the schools where students want to do internships. The top roles offered in this course are physical education teacher.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: A good college for physical education.

content.Placements: Actually, there is no placement in our college but in every KVS exam and interview, our college staff will be there, and also for the assistant professor job or coach vacancy in our college. There will be preference for our college students; most of the staff are passed out from this college.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is very good, like class rooms, a football field, a hockey field, a multipurpose hall auditorium and also a big library with wifi AC and also a study room. Also, the hostel is not that advanced, but it's also good, like lot of free place are there, that is good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Best college of physical education all over Asia.

content.Placements: An average of 50% of students get placed every year. The average package is around 5 to 6 lacs per annum. Private schools and colleges come every year to recruit students. After completing the 3rd year, the college sends all the students on an internship programme to different schools.
content.Infrastructure: The college has advanced technologies for doing practical work in the field of physical education. It has its own big library with foreign journals and books that are not easily available. The classroom has good furniture and a digital class board for advanced learning. The food at the hostel is very good in comparison to other colleges. The college has every sports field and piece of equipment that you would have heard of.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I have given an honest review and reasonable answers.

content.Placements: Almost everyone gets a job after the course because the college has a reputation in India. admission_process.title: WCTM Gurgaon Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: As per the WCTM official website, the admission process for all courses is conducted online. Students who meet the eligibility criteria can fill out the application form before the deadline. Check out the completeWCTM admission processbelow:
1: WCTM Gurgaon Application Process 2025

The WCTM application forms are released on the official website of the college. Students need to pay an application fee to register for a course.  Students also need to upload their marksheets, certificates and other documents while filling out the application form.
2: Selection

World College of Technology and Management shortlists students for admission based on their merit in the last qualifying exam. Direct admission or interview-based selection is available for all courses.  Students can also apply with a valid score in CAT and GATE for MBA and MTech courses, respectively. For BTech, students can provide their JEE Main score. However, it is not mandatory for admission.
3: Admission Confirmation
Selected students must pay theWCTM Gurgaon feesand come for the document verification round to confirm their admission.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best ROI college in Gurgaon.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college. I recommend students get admission here. ROI is good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is average, and classrooms are well-maintained. A total of 8 computer labs are present. The hostel facility is also good. The campus is very cool. On the campus, a temple and two gardens are also present.

reviews.review_heading: Reality: Truth about WCTM
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not very good or modern, but facilities like water and washrooms are provided. Talking about the girls' hostel, it is very strict, they don’t have fixed rules and make new ones every day depending on the warden’s mood. The boys' hostel is better, as there are fixed rules.

reviews.review_heading: Currently, as a fresher, I am enjoying being here. It has supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a nice infrastructure. The hostel infrastructure is very good. The food in the mess is very delicious. It is way better than any other mess in any other hostel. If we want to have some snacks, then there are multiple canteens and a cafe inside the campus where we can enjoy our snacks. Each classroom is air-conditioned. Benches present in classrooms are really comfortable.

reviews.review_heading: Totally, I would say it has great facilities, and college life is also good.
reviews.review_text: It has great facilities, food, rooms with AC, and a very good environment for study. Many sports tournaments are also held on campus. In the hostel, there are TV rooms and many other facilities also provided for students for entertainment as well as study. Overall, I would say it has great facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is quite a nice private college for engineering and other courses as well.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is kind of good. Classrooms and the library have AC, and we have decent labs for every subject. Recently renovated buildings, as well as a newly built auditorium. Hostels are good, but the food is average. It's a little strict in terms of the girls' hostel.

reviews.review_heading: It's pretty much all you expect from a tier 3 college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is adequate, but power cuts happen frequently, only for a minute or so. You are not allowed to roam freely or play any sports provided. The college campus has a good Wi-Fi connection, but it's not provided to students. However, labs are fully equipped.

reviews.review_heading: If you are looking for a great, fun type of college, it could be one. The fests here are amazing.
reviews.review_text: The campus is big. It has 3 big sports grounds with 2 main buildings for classes. Wi-Fi is everywhere on the campus. Classrooms are big. The college has a robotics arm lab on campus, including an Apple Mac lab. The library has a lot of books. Also, the hostel is good, it has gym inside.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is the best in placement and facilities. The infrastructure is also very good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good in our college. There are lots of labs like Apple iOS lab, Centre of Excellence, and a central library. All classrooms have AC and projectors. Hostels are so good, all rooms are fully well-maintained. In our hostel, there is a common room and a TV room. The food at mess is also decent.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placement and faculty is nice.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are good. For example, the Wi-Fi speed is fast, the labs are well organized, and everything works nicely. Classrooms are also in good condition. Library is very good. It is very big and contains a lot of books for the curriculum. The quality of food is very good, and most of the sports are available.

reviews.review_heading: It has good placements and average infrastructure. I am satisfied because of facilities.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi facility in our college is good. There are labs for many things, like the Apple lab, a workshop technology lab, Physics lab, etc., and they are nice. Our classrooms are also great. The hostel is nice, but the light is not constant, and because of that, Wi-Fi is also not available when the light goes off. However, the food facility is good, and we also get a special dinner.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty, good placements in 2024, and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are good. Both work properly, but sometimes they don't work well. However, the service is very good. In my hostel, all facilities are good, but the mess food is average and not very tasty. The canteen is very good.

reviews.review_text: Our college comprises numerous departments for both aided and self-finance students. Each department boasts separate Wi-Fi, a library, and classrooms, while the science department is equipped with labs. Infrastructure-wise, our college features a wide-ranging campus. The hostel food was above average for both students and staff.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty and good placements in 2024.
reviews.review_text: The college has many facilities like Wi-Fi, neat classrooms with LED projectors, and a big library to gain information. The hostel food is very nice. The sports masters are kind to us. We can make many presence in sports. Our college sports academy is the best in Madurai district.

reviews.review_heading: It is a wonderful college but I am dissatisfied with some people.
reviews.review_text: Free Wi-Fi is available over the campus. We can use it for valuable purposes. There are systems in the library, that can be used for academic purposes and to improve knowledge. There are separate computer labs for curriculum practices. There is a main library and department libraries.

People from various places have good opinions of this college. The college has many facilities like food for long travelers, Wi-Fi for students, canteens, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely Satisfied with the Facilities and Top-Class Placement.
reviews.review_text: Consumption is almost stable. There is a greenery story. Although the refrigerator is located downtown, it is located on campus. The hotel is very nice. The food is worth the money. Discipline is maintained where necessary. The hostel is a beautiful place to stay. Laboratories are fully equipped and furnished with modern equipment. They have access to equipment and tests.

reviews.review_heading: The American college is good for English  education .
reviews.review_text: The hostel of the college is very beautiful and full of discipline. There are separate hostels for boys and girls. The college has three buildings, and each has beautiful classrooms and auditorium rooms. Wi-Fi facility is available, and there is also a large library and laboratory.

reviews.review_heading: I chose this course to become a data analyst.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are maintained by the non-teaching staff, particularly posted for the department also. Classrooms can be occupied by 80 to 85 students. The hostel is available for both boys and girls individually inside the campus, where it is constructed in a way that students get the utmost comfort. The hostel mess p...

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the learning methodology and helps the students to get placed.
reviews.review_text: The college is one of the best places for infrastructure that wonders the people who visit for the first time. The food and the canteen are maintained with hygiene for the students and staff. The staff is also responsible for the hygiene and safety environment.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with friendly facilities and awesome atmosphere, really the best curriculum.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are maintained by the non-teaching staff, particularly posted for the department. Wide classrooms can be occupied by 70 to 75 students. The best books and subject books are available in the main library. The curriculum-following books are available in the specific department library. Three canteens with awesome flavored foods.

reviews.review_heading: American College Review .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very old, built by the Americans in the year 1881. The campus is green and plastic free. WiFi, laboratories, library and the classrooms are available. It has all the basic facilities required including canteen facilities. All the sports and games activities are present.

reviews.review_heading: Best faculty, good placement in 2023.
reviews.review_text: Departments provide Wi-Fi connection. Labs are very clean, and the apparatus is in good condition. Classrooms are of a reasonable size. Hostel food is very good and tasty. There are mess and canteen facilities available, and medical facilities are also provided. Sports and games are available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in Madurai.
reviews.review_text: Our institution provides clean and spacious hostels for both boys and girls. We have three women's hostels and one men's hostel. We have a capacious mess in the hostel, and we are provided with hygienic food, both vegetarian and non-vegetarian. We have Wi-Fi facilities for educational purposes. And we have three canteens and small stalls on our campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is totally a good college which values for the money paid. We could acquire more knowledge.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure was pretty good and peaceful. It surrounded by greenery. Inside the campus free Wi-Fi is available. Hostel facilities also available inside the campus. Mess food is average. Food also available in the canteen and the price will also affordable. Classroom is enough for the strength of the students.

reviews.review_heading: Fully satisfied with the faculty, college environment, and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, and all other facilities are available. In our college library, more than 10,000 books are available. The library is very easy to use and atomized. The Wi-Fi is good. The college environment is very nice, fully surrounded by trees and plants. The hostel has good food.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good and getting good marks will take to you the placement.
reviews.review_text: The Labs, library, department functions, more classes, canteen, and the hostel are just good not too good. Sometimes the hostel food is so bad we can't eat so we eat the food from outside of the college. The sports are cricket, football basketball, kabaddi, badminton, Athletics handball etc.

individual_reviews.title: My college review with all problems I have faced.

content.Placements: The highest package is 8 LPA and 2 LPA is the lowest package in our college. Less than 5% of students got placed in college and more than 5 to 6 companies visit for placements. Infosys is the top recruiting company for our course, with 4% of students securing placements there in this financial year.
content.Infrastructure: We have old computers in our labs and only one lab has the latest computers, half of the computers are not working, which means features do not work. Wi-Fi is not working. Sports facilities are not good and canteen is average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Good placements in this college with really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: The college was perfect but the placements are not good. 20% is the placements rate here. Most students self study and get placed on their own. The highest package offered is 6 lacs and the lowest package is 3 lacs in this college. No top recruiting companies come in this college. Bachelor’s of Technology is best field for the students.
content.Infrastructure: In this college, Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms are available. Library is provided in the college having all the types of books for the students. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The placement and faculty of the college were good.

content.Placements: In college, 40–45% of students get placements in this branch of engineering. The highest package offered was 11 LPA. The lowest package offered was 3 LPAs. content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for our course was good. The college had good-quality facilities for our department. The labs of the college had all the necessary facilities. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Best college in Indore; teachers are very friendly.

content.Placements: From the 6th semester, students can apply for placements in companies like accenture, wipro, and Tcs. The average package is 3 LPA, and the highest package is 16lpa. Almost 50-60% students get placement from this college.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is very good. Hostel is not available. Bus facility is available, free of cost. Library is available. Wi-Fi is available only for the teachers, and in labs. Small temple of goddess Saraswati is also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is an excellent college with teachers, facilities, and infrastructure.

content.Placements: In our college, almost 75% of students are placed. Top recruiting companies like TCS, Infosys, Accenture, etc., visit our campus. Top roles offered are software engineer, software developer, data analyst, programmer, etc. The highest salary package offered is 17.6 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 3.3 LPA. Almost 80% of students get internships at TCS and Accenture.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are available at our college. Wi-Fi is available. Our lab facilities are good. Our classrooms are huge, very clean, and well-equipped. SIES School of Business Studies offers a diverse range of programmes to students. The college offers PGDM programme to students as its flagship course. These courses are offered for a duration of 2 years. SIES SBS courses are offered in full-time mode and in several specialisations. Some of the popular specialisations offered under this course are Marketing, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, Business Analytics, Pharmaceutical Management, and Biotechnology Management.
SIES SBS courses strive to enhance the learning experience of students to prepare them for the industry. Further, the college has a proven track record of its alumni leading in top positions across industries such as Finance, Consulting, Marketing, HR, and Pharma. admission_overview.description: SIES School of Business Studies admission is completely entrance-based. The SIES School of Business Studies offers a two-year PGDM programme across multiple specialisations. To get admission, candidates are required to qualify for one entrance exam, such as CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT, MH-CET and ATMA to participate in the selection process. After this, merit list is created and your admission is confirmed.

reviews_list.review_title: College review of NIT Kurukshetra.

review_content.Placements: Placements in mechanical department are decent every year, statistically around 70 percent of students are placed. The highest and lowest might differ each year but on average, the CTC could be 7.5 LPA. Major recruiters for mechanical engineers are Tata, HUL, Maruti Suzuki, Honda, Hero, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: All classrooms have digital boards for a better learning experience. As for hostels, the occupancy is decent for accommodating all students. Mess food is fine. Technical fests are pretty interesting, and the ambience of that is good too. All necessary facilities like hospital, etc., are accessible 24X7.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Industrial Internet of Things Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: It's a good college. It has all the facilities, but weather makes it difficult, though manageable.

review_content.Placements: Placements have been quite sound this year with companies like Uber, Meesho, and Make My Trip already picking up students and giving around 15 LPA for students of major branches like computer science, electronics and communication engineering as well.
review_content.Infrastructure: The availability of network services is not fulfilling even mobile network of some SIMs do not work. The hostels do not have Wi-Fi. They have LAN service which does not allow WhatsApp to run as well. The quality of food is not that great. The rotis are made from machines and are mostly raw and incredible though. The medical facilities are top-notch. Sports facilities are also maintained well. Due to the extreme heat, sometimes the ACs feel worthless.

overview_faqs.question: Is NIT Kurukshetra worth it?
overview_faqs.answer: NIT Kurukshetra gives BTech and MTech programmes, as well as MBA, MCA, and PhD programmes across Engineering, Sciences and Humanities and Social Sciences streams. NIT Kurukshetra is famous for its BTech course. Admission is based on JEE Mains rank and counselling. The highest and average package offered during NIT Kurukshetra BTech placements 2023 was INR 62.75 LPA and INR 14.16 LPA, respectively.

overview_faqs.question: What is campus life like at NIT Kurukshetra?
overview_faqs.answer: NIT Kurukshetra campus spreads over 300 acres. It has been divided into three functional sectors: the instructional sector, the residential sector for the employees, and the residential sector for the students (hostels). Students can find lodging in hostels because they are residential institutions. The MTech students are accommodated in PG hostels. NIT Kurukshetra has a very spacious library with a good collection of documents, including text and reference books, video cassettes, CD-ROMs, and many print and online journals and books. The infrastructure facilities include eight blocks and a workshop. Each block has offices for the staff, lecture halls, tutorial rooms, and various laboratories.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Kurukshetra Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: NIT Kurukshetra College Review.

content.Placements: Mechanical engineering at NIT Kurukshetra has good placements as well. Around 86% of students get placed. The average package is 9 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the highest reaches 18 LPA. Top companies like Tata, Hero Motors, and Mahindra visit the campus. Around 80% of students also get internships in core companies.
content.Infrastructure: The department provides Wi-Fi, and the labs are well-maintained. The classrooms are spacious, and the library has an excellent collection. The hostels are generally good and kept clean, but the food in the mess and food street is just average. There are basic medical facilities and plenty of sports and recreation options too, so you won't really feel bored.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: NIT KURUKSHETRA - My 4 years of journey.

content.Placements: There is a strength of 120 students in CSE in B.Teach. Currently, the median package is going on 21-22 LPA. Placement of CSE is at the top level as compared to all other branches. An internship is also good. You can crack placement/ internship off-campus ( I mean, there is a huge scope. Many students crack Google, Microsoft off-campus). Placement as an NIT is good.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel rooms are good if you are adjustable until you are living in the H6 hostel. Washing Machines are available. Laundry man is available, but he is costly. Bring your iron also. Table tennis, chess, volleyball, badminton, cricket. TV screens are available in each hostel. In the seniors' hostel, a gym is also available. Talking about messy food, it is like okay. H3 mess food is good (best). The rest of us have to survive like you. No Wi-Fi only Lawns connection.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College review of NIT Kurukshetra.

content.Placements: Placements in mechanical department are decent every year, statistically around 70 percent of students are placed. The highest and lowest might differ each year but on average, the CTC could be 7.5 LPA. Major recruiters for mechanical engineers are Tata, HUL, Maruti Suzuki, Honda, Hero, etc.
content.Infrastructure: All classrooms have digital boards for a better learning experience. As for hostels, the occupancy is decent for accommodating all students. Mess food is fine. Technical fests are pretty interesting, and the ambience of that is good too. All necessary facilities like hospital, etc., are accessible 24X7.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Industrial Internet of Things Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It's a good college. It has all the facilities, but weather makes it difficult, though manageable.

content.Placements: Placements have been quite sound this year with companies like Uber, Meesho, and Make My Trip already picking up students and giving around 15 LPA for students of major branches like computer science, electronics and communication engineering as well.
content.Infrastructure: The availability of network services is not fulfilling even mobile network of some SIMs do not work. The hostels do not have Wi-Fi. They have LAN service which does not allow WhatsApp to run as well. The quality of food is not that great. The rotis are made from machines and are mostly raw and incredible though. The medical facilities are top-notch. Sports facilities are also maintained well. Due to the extreme heat, sometimes the ACs feel worthless.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The honest review of NIT Kurukshetra.

content.Placements: About 71% of students are placed in our course. The highest package is 51 LPA, the lowest is 5.6 LPA, and average is 14 LPA. Top companies include Amazon, Flipkart, and Meesho. Many students got internships in 3rd year on basis of their skills. The roles vary as per individual choice, some may be in embedded system i.e., hardware side while some in software technical jobs profile.
content.Infrastructure: All the classes are air-conditioned but some of the ACs don't work properly in our class. Our institute has a big central library which has a lot of books but as a student we don't have enough time to read those books. All the apparatus is in good condition, and performing the experiments by yourself is very enjoyable. But when the lecture is given about how to proceed and what the theory is about experiments are very boring. Hostel facilities are also decent. Sometimes mess food may not be too good. Every sports facility is present.

admission_process.title: NIT Kurukshetra Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: NIT Kurukshetra admission process includes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list, and counselling. Find below the complete process for NIT Kurukshetra admission 2025:
Step 1: NIT Kurukshetra Application Process

Interested individuals looking to apply for admission, to NIT Kurukshetra should start by filling out the application form found on the website of the institute. The application process varies based on the programme being applied for; For courses such as BTech applicants are required to take the JEE Main exam and submit their applications through JoSSA Counselling; for postgraduate programs like MTech and MSc candidates must apply via the relevant entrance exams such as GATE, for MTech and IIT JAM for MSc.; while those seeking PhD admissions need to apply through the institute's website.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to BTech programmes at NIT Kurukshetra depends on the candidates' performance in JEE Main; however, eligible candidates are allocated seats via JoSAA Counselling. For MTech programmes, candidates must possess a valid GATE score and participate in CCMT Counselling.
Step 3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

The cutoff lists for the courses are published by NIT Kurukshetra upon completing the selection rounds. The corresponding counselling bodies make these lists available to candidates. The candidates shortlisted need to confirm their admission by making the requisite admission fee within the given timeframe.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Kurukshetra College Review.
reviews.review_text: The department provides Wi-Fi, and the labs are well-maintained. The classrooms are spacious, and the library has an excellent collection. The hostels are generally good and kept clean, but the food in the mess and food street is just average. There are basic medical facilities and plenty of sports and recreation options too, so you won't really feel bored.

reviews.review_heading: NIT KURUKSHETRA - My 4 years of journey.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are good if you are adjustable until you are living in the H6 hostel. Washing Machines are available. Laundry man is available, but he is costly. Bring your iron also. Table tennis, chess, volleyball, badminton, cricket. TV screens are available in each hostel. In the seniors' hostel, a gym is also available. Talking about messy food, it is like okay. H3 mess food is good (best). The rest of us have to survive like you. No Wi-Fi only Lawns connection.

reviews.review_heading: College review of NIT Kurukshetra.
reviews.review_text: All classrooms have digital boards for a better learning experience. As for hostels, the occupancy is decent for accommodating all students. Mess food is fine. Technical fests are pretty interesting, and the ambience of that is good too. All necessary facilities like hospital, etc., are accessible 24X7.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college. It has all the facilities, but weather makes it difficult, though manageable.
reviews.review_text: The availability of network services is not fulfilling even mobile network of some SIMs do not work. The hostels do not have Wi-Fi. They have LAN service which does not allow WhatsApp to run as well. The quality of food is not that great. The rotis are made from machines and are mostly raw and incredible though. The medical facilities are top-notch. Sports facilities are also maintained well. Due to the extreme heat, sometimes the ACs feel worthless.

reviews.review_heading: The honest review of NIT Kurukshetra.
reviews.review_text: All the classes are air-conditioned but some of the ACs don't work properly in our class. Our institute has a big central library which has a lot of books but as a student we don't have enough time to read those books. All the apparatus is in good condition, and performing the experiments by yourself is very enjoyable. But when the lecture is given about how to proceed and what the theory is about experiments are very boring. Hostel facilities are also decent. Sometimes mess food may not be too ...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely right review of my college.
reviews.review_text: Our course infrastructure is nice. AC equipped classrooms with smart boards. All computer centers are also equipped with a LAN. There is Wi-Fi in the library, but it does not work properly. Hostel are of old style but with proper hygiene. Mess food is good, but here, chapati is not that good. It also has large grounds in the hostel with the security of Dogesh Bhai. There is a health center and sports complex with all the games.

college_info.college_name: NIT Kurukshetra Scholarship Details

paragraphs: NIT Kurukshetra offers various scholarships to its students. NIT Kurukshetra students can avail of Merit-cum-Means Scholarships, the Central Sector Scholarship Scheme for SC students, and Alumni Association Scholarships.

There are various scholarships under Merit-cum-Means Scholarships, such as the OP Jindal Engineering and Management Scholarship, which is given to the first three toppers (Engineering) and the first ten (Management) on the basis of performance during the whole course.

The Central Sector Scholarship Scheme for SC students offers 26 merit scholarships and 52 merit-cum-means scholarships are awarded by the institute for each year of BTech degree courses. In addition to these, National Scholarships, Post-metric Scholarship, and many other stipends are awarded by various Government institutions and other agencies.

NITK also offers Alumni Association awards. There are 5 scholarships (one each in the disciplines of Civil, Computer, Electronics Electrical, and Mechanical Engineering) of the value of INR 2400 per annum that are open to all regular BTech students of the institute.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nautical Science - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good for knowledge but not for placement.

content.Placements: It was there some years ago, but since the year I joined, the placement has dropped, and only a few cadets are getting placed here. It's not even 50%. They're trying to place us, but not in good companies. Firstly, they assured us that they would provide 100% placement, but I can't see them staying true to their word.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure was good when it was built, but the maintenance by the college is very poor. They choose the cheapest way to repair and use that material for a long time. Accommodation isn't enough for boys who stay in a group in one room. The food quality isn't too good; we have to raise our voice every time for food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I am very happy, absolutely satisfied.

content.Placements: Our batch has students from CSE (AI&ML). Overall, it is a very active and successful batch. The placement record of our course is quite good compared to other streams in the same year. Almost 75-80 percent of students are placed in various reputed companies. The average package is 4-5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is quite good and supports the overall academic environment, with spacious and well-ventilated classrooms with proper seating arrangements, all classes containing projects and Wi-Fi, a library, and good sports facilities on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good faculty, a beautiful campus, nice people, and good placement.

content.Placements: 80-90% of students were placed. The average package is 4-5 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Wipro, Infosys, Tata Motors, etc. 80% of students got internships at Spider X, Tata Motors, Wipro, Infosys, and other companies. Our top roles in these companies are web developer, software developer, data scientist, cloud engineer, and software tester.
content.Infrastructure: We have smart classrooms, Wi-Fi availability in hostels, a swimming pool, a multipurpose hall, playgrounds, and every sports facility, as well as a medical hub for health issues, cafeterias, and opportunities for singing, dancing, public speaking, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: TNU appears to offer a solid campus life with good infrastructure and helpful faculty.

content.Placements: For the academic year 2023–2024, TNU reported an overall 71.97 percent placement rate. For the CSE (AI & ML) stream specifically, 75–80 percent of students are placed when companies visited the campus. The average package is 4.5–5 LPA in 2024. During campus placements (in the 4th year), for CSE (AI & ML) the highest package is 15 LPA, and the lowest package is 4 LPA. Some of the recruiting companies are Wipro, Tech Mahindra, TCS, HCL, and Lenskart.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is consistently described as spacious and well-equipped, with a "green, clean" environment and a variety of amenities. Classrooms are often smart and digital. smart boards and labs are available for various departments. The central library is frequently praised.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: The facilities and the quality of education could be improved, somehow, I am satisfied.

content.Placements: Around 30 percent of students got placed from my course. The highest package is 12LPA, the lowest is 2.5 LPA, and the average is 4 LPA. TCS and Wipro are recruiting companies. 90% of the students got internships in Weble, Dataapace Academy, AI labs, etc. Roles offered are Trainer, Analyst, etc. So not that much, but my college gives placement.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is quite good, it's a green campus, trees are planted everywhere, and each department has a separate building. Roads are good, and hostels are also good. But classrooms are non-AC and desks vary in each class. And also, it's too hot in the summer in the classes.

admission_process.title: The Neotia University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: The Neotia University admissionis primarily entrance-based. The university provides several programmes at undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral courses in the fields of Engineering, Architecture, Computer Applications, Microbiology, Science, Management, and more. The admission process for the university commences online. Also known asTNU, students are accepted based on their performance in the last qualifying exam. Interested students can read the following article to know about the courses, eligibility, selection criteria, and admission process for The Neotia University.

The Neotia University course admissionis subject to clearance of the preset eligibility. Students seeking to enrol in any of the offered courses are required to qualify for the admission criteria and apply as per the university's guidelines. Those seeking admission into the UG courses need to have passed Class 12 with relevant subjects. Similarly, for PG admissions. candidates must have passed graduation. To get into the PhD courses, students need to have a PG degree in the relevant field. Additionally, candidates must appear for the entrance test/ PI conducted by the university. Students can check out the following table to know about the eligibility and selection criteria forTNU courses:
Class 12 with 60% aggregate in the Science stream from a recognised board
Class 12 with 60% aggregate in Science stream (55% for BSc- RMI, 50% for BHHA, BHHA with Swiss Diploma) from a recognised board
Class 12 with 50% to 60% aggregate in relevant stream from a recognised board
BSc with 55% aggregate in a relevant discipline from a recognised university
BTech/ BE with 60% aggregate in a relevant discipline from a recognised university
Class 12 with 60% aggregate from a recognised board
Class 12 with 50% aggregate in Commerce stream from a recognised board
Bachelor's degree with 55% aggregate from a recognised university
Master's degree with at least 55% aggregate from a recognised university
Step 1: TNU Application Process

Candidates can participate in the TNU admission process by filling out an application form in online mode. Candidates can either visit the official website. They also must pay an application fee for UG & PG courses at the time of submitting the application form.
Step 2: TNU Selection Round

The Neoti University admissions are entrance-based. Students are offered admission based on candidates' past academic merit for UG & PG courses, respectively. For UG courses, students need to appear for the entrance exam conducted by the university. However, for PG courses, candidates must also appear for the PI round.

As part of the course curriculum, Neotia University students have interned at various Corporate Houses, Research Institutes, and Healthcare Organizations, such as WABCO, Amazon Development Centre India, Serum Institute of India, NIMHANS, Apollo Gleneagles, Hyatt Regency, The Lalit Great Eastern, and many more.

Neotia University has released the placement stats for the Class of 2024. As per the latest report, Neotia University recorded 71.97% overall placements in the academic year 2023-2024. A total of 503 students registered for the placement assistance of which 362 were placed in reputed companies. The Neotia University average package offered to the CSE Data Science students in 2024 stood at INR 4.2 LPA . Further, the average package offered to BBA and BA LLB students during Neotia University placements in 2024 was INR 4.22 LPA and INR 3 LPA , respectively.

The participating recruiters placed 18 BBA students, 7 BCom, 3 BA LLB, 4 BBA LLB, 45 BHM students during Neotia University placements 2024. The top recruiters of Neotia University in 2024 included QSpiders, TCS, Intellipaat, Lenskart , Wipro, Tech Mahindra, HCL, Trident , etc.

reviews.review_heading: Good for knowledge but not for placement.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was good when it was built, but the maintenance by the college is very poor. They choose the cheapest way to repair and use that material for a long time. Accommodation isn't enough for boys who stay in a group in one room. The food quality isn't too good; we have to raise our voice every time for food.

reviews.review_heading: I am very happy, absolutely satisfied.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is quite good and supports the overall academic environment, with spacious and well-ventilated classrooms with proper seating arrangements, all classes containing projects and Wi-Fi, a library, and good sports facilities on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, a beautiful campus, nice people, and good placement.
reviews.review_text: We have smart classrooms, Wi-Fi availability in hostels, a swimming pool, a multipurpose hall, playgrounds, and every sports facility, as well as a medical hub for health issues, cafeterias, and opportunities for singing, dancing, public speaking, etc.

reviews.review_heading: TNU appears to offer a solid campus life with good infrastructure and helpful faculty.
reviews.review_text: The campus is consistently described as spacious and well-equipped, with a "green, clean" environment and a variety of amenities. Classrooms are often smart and digital. smart boards and labs are available for various departments. The central library is frequently praised.

reviews.review_heading: The facilities and the quality of education could be improved, somehow, I am satisfied.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is quite good, it's a green campus, trees are planted everywhere, and each department has a separate building. Roads are good, and hostels are also good. But classrooms are non-AC and desks vary in each class. And also, it's too hot in the summer in the classes.

reviews.review_heading: This college is capable for higher studies .
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good. Classrooms are digital, and every lab is present in the department for each subject. Library is also present in the department. The quality of the facilities in our hostel is not bad. Hostel graduation are here in hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Review of agriculture department.
reviews.review_text: Our campus has excellent infrastructure and facilities for students. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and there is a swimming pool and a gym for the students. The labs are equipped with modern machines and equipment, which the students can use for experiments.

reviews.review_heading: This college is also good for higher studies and to pursue a better career.
reviews.review_text: The library is also present in our department. The classroom is digital. Labs are present in our department for each subject. The university campus is big. Two football grounds are present, one of them small and the other is big.

reviews.review_heading: This college is also good for higher studies.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good in our college. All facilities are available in our department. The library and digital classroom room also present. Labs were present in the department for each subject. CCTV is available on our campus.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure, average faculty members, and good placement.
reviews.review_text: Our department offers smart classrooms, Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, and a resourceful library. Hostel facilities are decent with clean rooms. Mess food is average but hygienic. Medical aid is available, and sports/games facilities support overall development.

reviews.review_heading: Don't miss the chance to study at this university.
reviews.review_text: To be honest, infrastructure is one of the best we have. Library, classroom, and labs are well decorated, neat and clean, and AC is provided with wi-fi. All facilities we are getting in hostel.

reviews.review_heading: In our department, 90% placement.
reviews.review_text: In our college, the Wi-Fi network is fast. The library and classes are good. Some classrooms have AC, but not all. Medical facilities are also present here that help you always.

reviews.review_heading: This is a very good college.
reviews.review_text: The college has an excellent infrastructure that creates a supportive and comfortable learning environment. The classrooms were spacious, well-ventilated, and equipped with modern teaching aids such as smart boards and projectors. The library was well stocked with a wide range of academic resources, reference books, and access to a digital learning platform.

reviews.review_heading: Great infra, average faculty.
reviews.review_text: Our department offers smart classrooms, Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, and a resourceful library. Hostel facilities are decent with clean rooms. The mess food is average but hygienic. Medical aid is available, and sports/games facilities support overall development.

reviews.review_heading: Green campus, average study.
reviews.review_text: I would genuinely say that the infrastructure can be better, and on the other hand, the facilities are quite good. Just a few classrooms and labs have AC, the rest of the others just have ceiling fans. Wi-Fi is mostly available everywhere on the campus. The central library is very huge and a good place to study.

college_info.college_name: The Neotia University Scholarship Details

paragraphs: The Neotia University offers several merit-based and need-based scholarships and sponsorships to deserving students. The university offers these scholarships in the form of fee waivers ranging from 25% to 100% on tuition fees.

Neotia University offers a list of scholarships for Indian, Nepal, and Bhutan international students based on students' marks in their last qualifying examination. For UG courses, scholarships will be given based on Class 12 (best of 5 subjects)/ Diploma. For PG, overall graduation marks will be considered. TNU doesn't have any fixed number of students to avail of the scholarships offered, and if a student is eligible as per the set criteria then he or she will be able to avail the scholarships. reviews.review_heading: IISU Jaipur College Review.
reviews.review_text: The department provides Wi-Fi, and the labs are well-maintained. The classrooms are spacious, and the library has a great collection of books. The hostels are usually good and kept clean, but the food in the mess and the food street is only average. They have basic medical facilities and lots of options for sports and fun, so you won't be bored. To be bored.

reviews.review_heading: IISU Jaipur college review.
reviews.review_text: The classroom setup was modern with a comfy chair. They had good air circulation and smart boards. The library had a massive number of books and resources and you can also access online collections. The college had a main research area that offers advanced analysis tools and was open to different fields of study. The boys hostels had rooms for two people. Each room comes with a Bed table, a chair, LAN internet access, a fan and enough storage space. The hostel serves four meals a day, including ...

reviews.review_heading: IISU Jaipur College Review.
reviews.review_text: Our department has excellent facilities. There’s Wi-Fi, the lab gear is in top condition, and the classrooms are clean, large, and have projectors. The library is huge, with more than 200,000 books. The medical and sports facilities are fantastic. The hostels might be a bit old and maybe not the best for second-year students, but they are okay for everyone else. The one negative thing is the food in the mess, which I would only give a 2 out of 5 rating.

reviews.review_heading: IISU Jaipur College Review.
reviews.review_text: A really good thing about the university is its modern facilities and extra features. The library is full of books and academic magazines. The canteen is big and has many kinds of food. Students are happy with the well-managed hostel, where the food is basic but meets good standards.

reviews.review_heading: IISU Jaipur College Review.
reviews.review_text: The college buildings and facilities are quite impressive. The library is a quiet place and has a great selection of books. The canteen serves healthy food. The hostel could be improved, but it's comfortable enough to stay in. The mess takes care of cleanliness, and the water supply is reliable.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIS (Deemed to be University).
reviews.review_text: The overall college setup is only average. The campus has Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, cozy classrooms, and a huge library. Since the library has so many books, students don't have to buy a lot of study materials from outside. It also has bus services and housing on campus. The dining hall is kept clean. The food served is decent, but it needs a few more popular dishes.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIS (Deemed to be University).
reviews.review_text: The campus buildings and grounds cover all the main needs. It has clean water, big science labs, an auditorium for events, a field for sports, and a library with lots of books. Classrooms are neat. The college provides bus service and places to live on campus for those who need them. The mess hall is clean, and the food is okay, though having a few more meal options would be better.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIS (Deemed to be University).
reviews.review_text: All classrooms are fully digital now. There are all kinds of labs we can imagine, from mechanical stuff to computer software. Every classroom has Wi-Fi. The main library has everything a student could ever need. The hostel rooms are decent with facilities like a bed, a table, and a chair. The quality of the food in the mess is good. It also has a small health clinic where we can get medical treatment.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIS (Deemed to be University).
reviews.review_text: The hostel building is good. It offers a ton of features, like a gym, a study room, a canteen that's open day and night, a bookstore, a badminton court, and other sports facilities. However, I find the mess food pretty disappointing. The whole campus has Wi-Fi and CCTV cameras for safety. There are a lot of coffee shops, restaurants, and even malls right on campus. There are many fields for different sports. Classrooms are big and have new digital equipment. The library is good and is open 24x7.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIS (Deemed to be University.
reviews.review_text: My department has really great facilities. The college buildings and grounds are just okay, but every student could use the classrooms and the library. There is no Wi-Fi. The food and service at my hostel canteen are absolutely fantastic. Sports and games are also good. The college has all facilities we need, from the basics to the more important stuff.

reviews.review_heading: IISU Jaipur College Review.
reviews.review_text: The campus has all the important academic buildings, a central library, well-equipped labs, and Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. Students can use residential facilities and dining halls. The hostel accommodation is considered satisfactory. The food in the mess is average, and there is health centre with medical staff available for students.

reviews.review_heading: IIS Jaipur College Review.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is quite impressive. The library is peaceful and has a good variety of books. The canteen serves nutritious meals. The hostel could be better, but it is comfortable enough. The mess maintains hygiene, and the water supply is reliable.

reviews.review_heading: I love faculty, but was unsure about the campus.
reviews.review_text: The college had ample facilities in the psychology department, with fully equipped labs, proper infrastructure, and commendable faculty. The canteen had a variety of options at relatively affordable prices. Other than that, there was also an Amul parlor, which offered milk and milk products at good pricing.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure, excellent faculty, and promising placements.
reviews.review_text: The university offers smart classrooms and well-equipped computer labs with all essential software. The library has a varied and good collection of books and also gives access to E-library. Basic medical care is available on campus. The campus also provides various sports options and has a gym too. Hostel rooms are clean and decent. The food is good and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of this university.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility of the university is good. All the rooms have ducting facility, separate living baths, RO water facility, and water theater facility. There are mainly breakfast, lunch, tea, and dinner. The quality of food is very good compared to others.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty and placements.
reviews.review_text: The college offers smart classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, modern labs, and a well-stocked library. Hostel rooms are clean with 24/7 water and power. Mess food is decent and hygienic. Medical care is available, and there are good sports and gym facilities too.

reviews.review_heading: College has good facilities provided, such as food, infrastructure, study labs, and a library.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was very super. My college had many more trees, a great ambiance for nature, and my classrooms also had very good labs and library facilities available. Wi-Fi was not available at the hostel side, but the food was normal, sports and games facilities were available, and its very memorable for my college.

reviews.review_heading: Best days and friendships in my life.
reviews.review_text: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan Engineering College offers good infrastructure with Wi-Fi, well equipped labs, spacious classrooms, and a large library. Hostels are decent with medical care, sports facilities, and average food in the mess and canteen. The best sports teams in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan Engineering College - DSEC.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities like libraries, smart classrooms, and labs. It provides 3 types of food like Kerala style food, Tamil Nadu style food, and Andhra Pradesh style food. The food sometimes really tastes well and sometimes waste. It provides biriyani every Sunday, and also provides ice cream weekly. For breakfast, we get a dosa, idli, chappathi, idiyappam, puttu, and lunch will be priced with the same or dal. At dinner, we get chappathi, parotta, ghee, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Decent college with supportive faculty, good infrastructure & growing placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The IT department has good labs, Wi-Fi, and spacious classrooms. The library is well-stocked and quiet. Hostel rooms are average, mess food is decent, and the canteen offers basic snacks. Medical aid is available on campus. Sports facilities include a big ground and courts for various games.

reviews.review_heading: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan Engineering College is absolutely one of the best engineering colleges.
reviews.review_text: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan Engineering College's infrastructure and facilities are good. It has more spacious and comfortable classrooms. Modern laboratories are available in this college. This college has good library facilities. Well-maintained hostels and hygienic food are also available in this college. Good sports grounds facilities are also available in this college.

reviews.review_heading: It will help to develop our future and help to grow ourselves.
reviews.review_text: More or less, all is there. All have studied above 3 degrees. Hostel is very strict, it is good. We have a hospital for good health on campus. The sports and games teams are there as spreading.

reviews.review_heading: Be good and cool.
reviews.review_text: Many facilities are available in our college like smart board facilities for each class, computer labs, physics and chemistry laboratory, and library. There are good facilities in hostel and hospital in college. Sports like cricket, basketball, and football are there.

reviews.review_heading: True side of college - It's true beauty.
reviews.review_text: There is no noticeable infrastructure here but it is decent. The quality of hostel food is below average. There is no proper routine for the food menu. Sports facilities are above average.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of placements and infrastructure but dissatisfied with labs.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi router is available on campus. Hostel has average speed of KBPS. In labs the system is old. Classrooms are clean but benches are damaged. The mess food is worst and canteen food is good. There is a hospital on campus. Sports are conducted like football, cricket, kabaddi, athletics, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Dhanalakshmi srinivasan engineering college is really one of the best college .
reviews.review_text: The college campus environment is very nice. More than 15 courses are available in this college. Good classrooms, more laboratories, well-equipped library, free Wi-Fi and atm facilities are available. The college has separate hostel for girls and boys. Hostel foods taste is good. The college conducts many sports events in every semester.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is good but faculty members makes it dissatisfied.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good because there are good classrooms but not modern. Wi-Fi is available in labs, hostel but not in classrooms. Library is not as expected. It's very small and not all books are available. The hostels are well maintained. Mess food is just average. Hostels for boys and girls are separate and girls hostels are not in reach to the boys so it's secure and good for girl's privacy.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: In my course, the subjects were easily understandable because of the well-trained staff and faculty members. There was lots of time to explain, even though the staff explained it crisply and clearly to the students for a good understanding of the subject. The hostel also provides some more study time and during that time the students can share their class experience and exchange thoughts about what they learned in class that day.

reviews.review_heading: The college infrastructure is average, but they provide good placements in under INR 3 LPAs.
reviews.review_text: The faculty have good knowledge but not more skilled personnel; they are not well versed in advanced technologies, and some staff have good teaching skills. The infrastructure is average, mainly the wi-fi on the campus. The labs and classrooms are good enough. The library is very nice on campus. The hostel facilities are average, and mainly the hostel foods are very bad; they don't wash the vegetables properly. The canteen is good enough, and medical facilities are also inside the college campus...

reviews.review_heading: The peaceful environment and green environment make us want to join college.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are really big when compared to other colleges. They provide a very good library facility where students can get subject-related books that help them take notes easily. The canteen in the college is good, they provide hygienic food, and they keep the place clean.

individual_reviews.title: Overall, the course curriculum of my college is good.

content.Placements: Our college provides on-campus internships and also off-campus internships. A few days back I got an internship letter through my university mail.
content.Infrastructure: There are sports facilities like chess, volleyball, table tennis, etc. on the campus itself.
content.Faculty: The student-to-teacher ratio is 12:05, Teachers are approachable and they answer all your queries as well. I liked Prashant Sahana sir, because the way he teaches is very fun-oriented and Gen Z code. The admission process was quick and they did not even ask for any entrance exam. The admission coordinator was also very well-behaved and supportive.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied because of faculty members, dissatisfied because of programs.

content.Placements: The college provides a good placement facility. And every senior is happy with the college. I am also happy, and I hope everyone will like the college on the basis of study. The programs that the college is providing are not good but studying at the college is good.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is good but not affordable for me. The hostel food is also good but I am from Kerala so I don't like the food from the hostel. I prefer the Kerala type of food so I chose PG, which is 7 km away from the college in the best area. I have good food now, but I only like Kerala food .

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: It is one of the best colleges.

content.Placements: Students were eligible for placements in their final year. Our college invited many companies like TCS, Amazon, Flipkart, Infosys, and Infotech. These companies visited our college and provided good jobs for students. The highest salary package offered was 22 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 12 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel was very good. The hostel rooms were good. Each hostel room had a bed, a table, a chair, a television, and an air conditioner. The food served in the hostel was good, very hygienic, and tasty. Our canteen providedes a variety of food items. The hostel fee was affordable.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our college is the best college for MBA.

content.Placements: This institute offers great placement opportunities to the participants of the courses during the 2 year long MBA programme. We have numerous marquee recruiters offering excellent job roles I. e. in the core of the different domains in sales and marketing, finance, general management etc. The information relating to the nature, no. Of recruiters along with the job roles offered are published on the institutes website after the successful completion of the recruitment process I. e. both summers and final placements. The institute has 100% placement of the students.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued(Sep 2024) - of Business Administration (MBA) + Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Good college for MBA, Really satisfied .

content.Placements: Placements are quite good. At least 30 of my class students were placed, class strength was 63. Top recruiting companies were sharekhan, Infosys, wipro, capgemini. Top roles offered were senior executive & team leader for one of my experienced friend. According to my knowledge the highest salary was 4,20,000 pa, average was 3,10,000 & the lowest was 2,40,000. Internship was quite good experience as my friends and I were placed in companies like grassroots, E&y. etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is the main topic to discuss, college is so well maintained and clean that you will get a cold breeze as soon as you enter college. In college, canteens and medical facilities are available. Every year, sports day is celebrated in our college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Computer Science - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Our college is very good, it is our college placement in the city of Jagannath.

content.Placements: Our college is a government autonomous college, and it provides a small number of placements, such as a maximum of 30 to 40 percent. The percentage of students is placed in different companies at a good package of 3 LPA to 8 LPA, but our college provides a good internship programme.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides a good classroom to all students and a good lab facility to different departments like the physics lab, Chemistry lab, Zoology lab, Botany lab, and computer lab for our department. The college authority provides a 24-hour Wi-Fi connection to our lab.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Now, our college is developed.

The top recruiting companies on our campus are Infosys, TCS, and Tech Mahindra. 70% of students got internships. Top roles are offered in the course.
content.Infrastructure: A library has a dedicated space within a school that provides access to a wide range of learning resources, primarily books, including periodicals, digital resources, and sometimes audio-visual materials. It serves as a hub for intellectual and literary activities, supporting students and teachers in learning and research.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Physics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good facilities with the best faculty; you can make your career shine here.

content.Placements: It's a good college, and the cutoff percentage needed to secure a seat in B.Sc. Physics is nearly 85%. Good students got placements all over India. A job mela program was conducted for students, where many companies hired them. It’s a good college with promising career options.

The hostel has good facilities and provides decent food.

admission_process.title: RGSC BHU Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Rajiv Gandhi South Campusoffers admission to UG and PG courses based on entrance exam scores. Candidates are first required to apply for the accepted entrance exam. Below are the steps to get a seat in RGSC BHU:
STEP 1: RGSC BHU Application Process 2025

Candidates can apply online for admission at RGSC BHU. For most of the UG courses, candidates will need to apply for CUET-UG. Aspirants applying for PG programmes need to fill out the CUET-PG application form. Candidates who wish to get admission without CUET score can apply on the official website of BHU.
STEP 2: Selection

The selection for UG courses such as BSc, BCom (Hons), BVoc and BMLT is based on CUET-UG score. For PG courses such as MSc, MVoc, MBA, etc. candidates need to pass CUET-PG exam. Candidates must score marks equal or above theRGSC BHU cutoffto get admission.
STEP 3: Counselling & Seat Allotment

Candidates are allotted seat in RGSC through BHU Counselling. Candidates after appearing for CUET-UG or CUET-PG exam need to participate in the counselling round. Selected aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the campus.
